title: End-to-end pipeline: images to verified spreadsheet
userStory: As a user, one call turns my captured receipts into a verified spreadsheet.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/receiptPipeline.js exports processReceipts(images, { vision }) that extracts each image (reusing extractReceipt) then builds the sheet (reusing buildReceiptSheet).
Returns { sheet: { csv, validation }, receipts }; needs-review flags from extraction are reflected in the sheet validation.
A single extraction failure is collected (not thrown) so the rest of the batch still produces a sheet; failures are reported in the result.
npm test passes with a fake vision client over multiple images (one clean, one flagged, one failing).
